items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I didn't build many kinds of it, because I played bass drum with Alfred.

ctx.x: We interviewed him. Yeah, yeah, he used to play in there. He loves drums. Yeah, he likes to play some drums. Yeah, yeah, he tried to play everything. He loves drums. But he never make a drummer. I tell you, you got a lot of them around here that never make it. Been playing the four hours. This fellow Rudolph, he played over there last Sunday. You saw him? Big Rudolph. You saw him last Sunday? Well, they wanted me to play, but after they had him, I can't play with them fellas. They asked me first, but I got that…
That's all what you're doing. Otherwise, things ain't going to go right.
